cases.name: Caroline Susan Bolen
cases.about: She only lived in Silsbee for about two weeks prior to her death. She moved to become an employee of St. Elizabeth Hospital in Beaumont, TX.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: Investigators believe that Mosley traveled to her home in the early morning hours of 7/28/1988, forced his way into the home when she came to the door, thinking it was her boyfriend, and brutally sexually assaulted her with her 6-year-old child present, before ultimately killing her by asphyxiation as she resisted, leaving behind critical biological evidence. An autopsy report indicated that she likely died from suffocation.
